decisions.reason: The product is close to the established offer and has been publicly mentioned, creating sunk-cost and justification pressures that favor persistence.
As a responsive website template close to the firm's core business, the public mention and existing investment make dropping unlikely under escalation of commitment.
Premium customer support is highly central to the firm's service promise and has been publicly mentioned, so management tends to persist with it.
The software version management tool has its own product page and builds directly on the established platform, indicating high public commitment and centrality that strongly discourage dropping.

Although the online tool for data processing contracts is distant from the core business, its dedicated page and product line with several models represent substantial sunk costs and public commitment, so management tends to persist despite somewhat higher risk.
